name: Website Settings-website_button_url
label: Website Button Target
description: Where the Website button in the Commons sidebar opens. An absolute URL (https://example.org) or a path on this site (/about). Leave blank to open the site root. This does not change where anyone lands after logging in — that is Home Page above, together with the Home Page on each Role.

name: Role-home_page_priority
label: Home Page Priority
description: Which Home Page wins when someone holds several roles that each name one. Lowest number wins; roles on the same number are settled by name, so the order is always the same on every site and every login. Only meaningful alongside Home Page above. Has no effect unless Enable Home Page Priority is ticked in Commons Settings.

name: Custom DocPerm-require_user_permission
label: Require User Permission
description: A role ticked here sees no records until a User Permission aimed at this doctype narrows it. Has no effect unless Enable Require User Permission Gate is ticked in Commons Settings.

name: DocPerm-require_user_permission
label: Require User Permission
description: A role ticked here sees no records until a User Permission aimed at this doctype narrows it. Has no effect unless Enable Require User Permission Gate is ticked in Commons Settings.

name: Custom Field-derived_from
label: Derived From
description: Show a value read live from a linked record instead of storing it: link_field.target_field, as in Fetch From. The target may itself be a derived field, which is how a value is reached through several links. The field becomes read-only and has no database column. Has no effect unless Enable Derived Docfields is ticked in Commons Settings.

name: Custom Field-derived_from_doctypes
label: Derived From DocTypes
description: Only when the link in Derived From is a Dynamic Link: the doctypes it may point at, one per line. Each must have the target field. Rows pointing anywhere else read as empty.

name: Custom Field-derived_in_wildcard
label: Include in Wildcard Queries
description: Also return this field when code asks for every field (fields="*"). Every such query then pays for the join, and code that writes those rows back may fail on the missing column, so leave this off unless you know the doctype is queried that way on purpose.

name: Customize Form Field-derived_from
label: Derived From
description: Show a value read live from a linked record instead of storing it: link_field.target_field, as in Fetch From. The target may itself be a derived field, which is how a value is reached through several links. The field becomes read-only and has no database column. Has no effect unless Enable Derived Docfields is ticked in Commons Settings.

name: Customize Form Field-derived_from_doctypes
label: Derived From DocTypes
description: Only when the link in Derived From is a Dynamic Link: the doctypes it may point at, one per line. Each must have the target field. Rows pointing anywhere else read as empty.

name: Customize Form Field-derived_in_wildcard
label: Include in Wildcard Queries
description: Also return this field when code asks for every field (fields="*"). Every such query then pays for the join, and code that writes those rows back may fail on the missing column, so leave this off unless you know the doctype is queried that way on purpose.

name: Email Template-email_condition
label: Show When
description: Offer the template only on documents for which this is true: an expression over doc, written the way a field's Depends On is, e.g. doc.docstatus == 1 or doc.application_status == "Approved". Blank offers it on every saved document.

name: Email Template-custom_recipient_fieldname
label: Recipient Field
description: The field of the document holding who the email goes to. An address is used as it stands; a Link, such as a Payment Entry's Party, is followed to the linked record's address, or its primary Contact's. Several fields can be given, separated by commas.

name: Email Template-custom_sending_account
label: Send From
description: Preselected as the sender, when the user has access to this account. Otherwise the user's own default is kept.

name: Email Template-custom_print_format
label: Print Format
description: Leave blank to attach the doctype's default print format.

name: Email Template-use_mjml
label: Design with MJML
description: Write the email in MJML, which lays it out to read well on a phone as well as on a desktop. Each save compiles it into the HTML that is sent, and ticks Use HTML. Jinja works anywhere in it, including a {% for %} around whole sections.

name: Notification-send_delay_minutes
label: Delay Sending (minutes)
description: Hold the email in the queue this long before it is sent. It shows as Scheduled on the document's timeline meanwhile, with Send Now and Don't Send on the form; cancelling the document takes it back. 0 sends it straight away.

name: Notification-once_across_amendments
label: Once Across Amendments
description: Don't email about a document amended from one this notification already emailed about, as when a submitted payment is cancelled, corrected and submitted again. If the earlier email was taken back when that document was cancelled, the amended one is still sent.

name: Communication-notification
label: Sent by Notification
description: The Notification whose email this is, when it is one. Set by Commons as the email is queued.

name: Web Template-print_section
label: Print

name: Web Template-context_prep
label: Context Prep
description: Python run in the Server Script sandbox before each print. The inputs are in inputs (for example inputs.student), and the printed document in doc when the Print Format passes one. Set values to a dict; its keys are the template's variables. Left empty, the template is given the inputs themselves. Only a Script Manager may change it.

name: Email Account-capture_document_type
label: Captures Become
description: What the scans emailed to this account are drafted as in Document Capture. They are read automatically only when the sender is a user on this site.
